dcoast_provenance.official_reference: BIG Peta Garis Pantai Skala 1:25.000, publication 2022
dcoast_provenance.derivation: BIG coastline anchor points plus a fixed westward offshore translation

properties.rationale: Two-kilometre-class westward benchmark strip. The landward anchors come from BIG features inside the published 2024 map envelope; the polygon does not reproduce or infer the 110 sampling stations.
properties.warning: Do not use for imagery download, quantitative modelling, or operational monitoring until the land-overlap/water-mask gate and domain review pass.
